source: Curated home-safety changes for the demo. Environmental and routine changes only; no medical advice.

fixes.title: Handrails on both sides of the stairs
fixes.detail: A continuous rail on each side gives a hand hold going up and down, whichever hand is free.

fixes.title: Motion-sensor lighting at the top and bottom of the stairs
fixes.detail: Lights that switch on by themselves avoid walking the stairs in the dark, especially in the evening.

fixes.title: High-contrast strips on step edges
fixes.detail: A visible edge on each tread makes the end of every step easier to see.

fixes.title: Non-slip treads
fixes.detail: Textured treads reduce slipping on smooth wooden steps.

fixes.title: Keep the stairs and landing clear
fixes.detail: No shoes, bags or boxes on the steps or the landing.

fixes.title: A seat near the foot of the stairs
fixes.detail: A place to sit before climbing or after coming down.

fixes.title: Secure or remove loose rugs
fixes.detail: Non-slip underlay or tape keeps rug edges flat.

fixes.title: Grab bars by the toilet and in the shower
fixes.detail: Fixed bars give support when sitting down, standing up and stepping in or out.
